title: Console noise: mascot freeze lines behind speed_diagnostics, and the ResizeObserver loop on video Resize
description: Fabio's DevTools 2026-10-22: [mascot] 'studio frozen 8 s, waiting on connecting-sparks.webm' after a pod connect aborted, and 784 '[uncaught] ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' in app.log, ~75/s in 2-4 s bursts, one per video Resize run. Gate the MPI-1142 mascot freeze lines behind speed_diagnostics like [slow-load]/[health]; fix the band false alarm (crew overtaking a connecting scene before its first frame left the pending check armed and the hidden clip decoding); find and fix the ResizeObserver feedback loop.
